lines.serbian: Ema živi u Kopenhagenu, ali njen muž je iz Beograda.
lines.croatian: Ema živi u Kopenhagenu, ali njezin muž je iz Beograda.
lines.english: Ema lives in Copenhagen, but her husband is from Belgrade.

lines.serbian: Svakog četvrtka posle posla ide na čas srpskog.
lines.croatian: Svakog četvrtka nakon posla ide na sat srpskog.
lines.english: Every Thursday after work she goes to a Serbian class.
There are six people in the group.

lines.serbian: Učiteljica se zove Jelena i uvek donosi kolače.
lines.croatian: Učiteljica se zove Jelena i uvijek donosi kolače.
lines.english: The teacher is called Jelena, and she always brings cakes.

lines.serbian: Danas uče kako da naruče hranu.
lines.english: Today they're learning how to order food.

lines.serbian: – Ema, šta želite da jedete? – pita Jelena.
lines.croatian: – Ema, što želite jesti? – pita Jelena.
lines.english: "Ema, what would you like to eat?" asks Jelena.
Ema thinks for a long time.
"I'd like some soup and one waiter."
Everyone laughs.
Jelena wipes away tears of laughter.
"Excellent! Mistakes are the best teachers."

lines.serbian: Na kraju časa dobijaju domaći zadatak.
lines.croatian: Na kraju sata dobivaju domaću zadaću.
lines.english: At the end of the class they get their homework.

lines.serbian: Moraju da pričaju sa nekim samo na srpskom.
lines.croatian: Moraju razgovarati s nekim samo na srpskom.
lines.english: They have to talk to someone only in Serbian.

lines.serbian: Te večeri Ema zove svekrvu u Beograd.
lines.croatian: Te večeri Ema zove svekrvu u Beograd.
lines.english: That evening Ema calls her mother-in-law in Belgrade.
"Good evening, Mum. How are you?"
There's silence on the line.
"Who is this?" asks her mother-in-law.
"Ema!"
"Ema?! You speak Serbian?"
Her mother-in-law cries with happiness.

lines.serbian: Od tada zove Emu svake nedelje.
lines.croatian: Od tada zove Emu svake nedjelje.
lines.english: Since then she has called Ema every Sunday.

lines.serbian: Razgovori traju dugo, a Ema uči brzo.
lines.croatian: Razgovori traju dugo, a Ema uči brzo.
lines.english: The calls go on for a long time, and Ema is learning fast.
